INT-backend-sql-rls adversary run against HEAD 30a4065036a917514fb4984fde73f87867f38619 (branch devin/1788854799-production-program-integration). Attack branch devin/pp/adv/backend-sql-rls-30a40650 @ 62a5aac68fb5f44eedb2a0f6164d7a272888dec0 adds ONLY supabase/tests/adv/ (10 SQL attacks + run_adv_attacks.sh); no production code, migration or existing test touched (git status before commit: only `?? supabase/tests/adv/`). Harness mirrors ./supabase/tests/run_rls_tests.sh exactly (same shim_auth.sql, same four migration histories fresh / production_20260906 / upstream_20260906 / ordered_20260907, Docker postgres:16), runs every attack file in its own psql -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 and prints one PASS/FAIL per (history, attack).

FULL RUN — VERIFIED: `./supabase/tests/adv/run_adv_attacks.sh > artifacts/adv/run_adv_attacks_full.log 2>&1` → exit 1; executed=40 passed=20 failed=20 skipped=0 (10 attacks × 4 histories; the 5 breaking attacks fail identically on all 4 histories, the 5 passing attacks pass on all 4). Artifact: run_adv_attacks_full.log (attachment URL above; artifacts/ is gitignored so it is not in the repo).
CANONICAL SUITE UNCHANGED — VERIFIED: `./supabase/tests/run_rls_tests.sh > artifacts/adv/baseline_rls_after.log 2>&1` → exit 0, 16 PASS markers (security_regression + account_deletion_operations + analysis_release_policy × 4 histories, plus the migration-history PASS lines); no FAIL/ERROR. Artifact: baseline_rls_after.log (attachment URL above).
Static: `bash -n supabase/tests/adv/run_adv_attacks.sh` → exit 0.

CONFIRMED BREAKS (all VERIFIED on the disposable DB, all 4 histories; production Supabase ucqnaiwqwjtgvlduiuib NOT touched, so production state is INFERRED to match because the same migrations are applied): see `breaks` — ADV-01 (P1 sign-in abort on long provider name), ADV-02 (P1 free_rating_ledger not tamper-proof for owner role), ADV-03 (P1 partial→scored relabel charges a rating), ADV-06 (P2 client forges permit states; forged released/expired backs a sync), ADV-04 (P3 grant drift incl. dead account_deletion_requests client writes). Note ADV-02/ADV-03 are owner-role (compromised backend / migration mistake / support SQL) paths — clients are correctly refused; severity P1 rather than P0 because no client role can reach them, but they violate the same §D2 ledger standard the repo already enforces for the other ledgers and the money invariants ('withheld results never consume a credit', 'anti-reset ledger').

PASSING ATTACKS (evidence of holding boundaries; each `./supabase/tests/adv/run_adv_attacks.sh adv_NN` → exit 0, executed=4 passed=4 failed=0 skipped=0, all VERIFIED in run_adv_attacks_full.log):
- ADV-05 supabase/tests/adv/adv_05_concurrent_sync_double_spend.sql — real concurrent sessions via dblink racing two scored syncs at the 2nd-free-rating boundary: exactly one accepted, the other gets access.paywall_required; same-shot replay from a second connection returns accepted without a second row/credit; no reserved permit stranded after the race (access_lock_key serialisation + lifetime_scored_count backstop hold).
- ADV-07 adv_07_account_switch_identity_isolation.sql — delete account + re-sign-in with the same Apple subject keeps lifetime_scored_count()=2 and reserve → access.paywall_required; access_state().scored_count=2; a different Google identity on the same device starts at 0 and gets one reservation; replaying A's outbox (A's shot ids/permit ids) as B is refused typed with no row for B; B cannot see/move A2's permits/sessions/shots under RLS; linking the spent Apple identity to B after B spent one → count=max(1,2)=2, no third rating (late-linked identity trigger holds).
- ADV-08 adv_08_api_gate_and_function_surface.sql — correct user with no x-pickle-api-key / wrong key / empty key and anon with the correct key: zero rows from profiles/sessions/analysis_permits/shots/billing_entitlements (or permission denied), no session insert/update lands, reserve_analysis_permit mints nothing, access_state() returns nothing true (premium/spend/reservations all hidden despite the seeded premium row + live reservation), identity_scored_count()=0, complete_onboarding() does not move onboarding_state; exact authenticated-callable function surface matches the expected list; anon can execute nothing; every SECURITY DEFINER function has a pinned search_path; no client role can execute get_api_request_key() or SELECT api_private.request_key; the only client-callable api_private functions are is_api_request()/is_active_session(); the real client shape (bearer + key) still reserves and sees premium/reserved_count=2.
- ADV-09 adv_09_malformed_sync_payloads.sql — 25 hostile apply_synced_shot() payloads on a premium account with a live permit each time (json array/null/string/{}, missing/invalid ids, foreign/missing permit, bad resultKind, score 99/-1/missing-for-scored, capturedAt garbage, 5k-char shotType, low_confidence with a score, phases not an array, phase with foreign shotId, sessionId not uuid). None wrote a row, moved lifetime_scored_count or settled the permit; outcomes recorded in the log (NOTICE 'ADV-09 outcomes'): typed access.* / shot.write_failed:<sqlstate> or a raised 22P02. Tolerated accepts (own-data only, edge parser rejects them upstream, noted as P3 observations not breaks): a numeric-string overallScore, contactMs<startMs, negative ms, and a spoofed userId field (ignored; row owned by auth.uid()).
- ADV-10 adv_10_collisions_sweeps_and_deleted_history.sql — B syncing a shot id owned by A is refused typed with no row for B, B's permit stays reserved and a fresh-id retry succeeds; pg_cron sweep to released/expired followed by an offline low_confidence lands as released/low_confidence with no rating counted and the same permit cannot back a second scored shot (access.permit_not_reserved); client attempts to reopen (finalized→reserved) or re-settle (→released/cancelled) a finalized permit are refused and the row is unchanged; owner-role purge of ALL of A's scored shots leaves lifetime_scored_count()=2, access_state().scored_count=2 and reserve → access.paywall_required (deleted history does not refund free ratings); owner delete of a finalized permit leaves a tombstone, a new shot on that permit id is refused, and a client INSERT re-creating the id as reserved is refused.

GENERAL CONDITIONS COVERAGE (SQL layer): happy path (ADV-05/07/08/09/10 fixtures), malformed input (ADV-09), repeated/double actions (ADV-05 replay + race, ADV-10 double-settle), interrupted session / process death / network loss (ADV-10 swept permit then late abstention; ADV-05 stranded-permit check), account switch (ADV-07), fresh install/re-sign-in (ADV-07), corrupt persisted state (ADV-03 relabel, ADV-06 forged states, ADV-10 tombstone/purged history), missing permissions (ADV-08 anon/no-key/wrong-key), slow responses (advisory-lock serialisation in ADV-05; no timing assertions made — UNKNOWN beyond correctness). Upgrade from both historical states: every attack executed on production_20260906 and upstream_20260906 as well as fresh and ordered_20260907 with identical results.

NOT_YET_VERIFIABLE (outside this area's Linux/SQL reach; no verdict guessed): (a) production Supabase grant/policy state on ucqnaiwqwjtgvlduiuib — would need `supabase migration list --linked` plus a read-only `psql "$SUPABASE_DB_URL" -c "select table_name, privilege_type, string_agg(column_name, ',') from information_schema.column_privileges where grantee='authenticated' and table_schema='public' group by 1,2"` run by the coordinator (this session did not touch production). (b) Whether real Apple/Google ID tokens can carry a >200-char name/avatar_url into raw_user_meta_data (ADV-01 exposure in the field) — would need a device sign-in with such an account through `POST /v1/account/bootstrap` against a staging project: `cd apps/mobile && npx react-native run-ios --mode Release` on a Mac + a test Apple ID with a 201-char name. (c) The mobile outbox behaviour after the SQL-layer refusals above (Jest/mobile is another agent's area).

OBSERVATIONS (not breaks): access_state() is SECURITY INVOKER and returns a zeroed row (premium=false, 0, 0) to a bearer with no/wrong API key instead of an error — no data leaks (VERIFIED in ADV-08), but a gated caller receives a fabricated 'fresh account' state rather than a refusal (P3, INFERRED impact: the shipping client always goes through the edge fn which sends the key). authenticated requires USAGE on api_private for the policy predicates; only the two boolean gates are callable there (VERIFIED).
